title: Acute hypotension
banner: DRAFT, NOT clinically reviewed. Fictional scenario specification; never imported, published or shown to learners.
learning_objectives: Treat the patient, not the number: check the patient and the monitoring system when a reading is implausible.

expected_actions.text: When an arterial pressure reading is unexpected, assess the patient and compare with a cuff reading before acting, then check the system and escalate if it cannot be corrected.
During a vasopressor infusion, inspect the infusion site and report extravasation or bradycardia.

gaps: No published clinical scenario may exist until the review phase: this is a specification only.
The branching content, consequences and scoring are the author's reading of the cited sources and have had no clinical review.
Causes and treatment of acute hypotension are not drawn from a source read.
